name: sonarqube
description: SonarQube integration — browse projects, quality gate status, issues, security hotspots, metrics, and analysis history, and assign issues, via the SonarQube Web API. Uses a static user token sent as a Bearer Authorization header (SonarQube Server 10.0+ and SonarQube Cloud); an optional organization key is appended for SonarQube Cloud. Works on the free Community Build.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: SonarQube code quality and security analysis

fields.label: SonarQube URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of your SonarQube server (e.g. https://sonarqube.mycompany.com) or https://sonarcloud.io for SonarQube Cloud.

fields.label: User Token
fields.helpText: Generate under My Account > Security > Generate Tokens. Sent as a Bearer Authorization header (SonarQube Server 10.0+/Cloud). Note: the /api/authentication/validate endpoint returns HTTP 200 with {"valid": false} for a bad token, so connection validation must check the response body, not just the status code.

fields.label: Organization Key
fields.helpText: SonarQube Cloud only: your organization key, appended as an organization= query parameter on every request. Leave empty for self-hosted SonarQube Server.

tools.name: sonar.search_projects
tools.description: List SonarQube projects visible to the token, with each project's key, name, and last analysis date.

tools.name: sonar.get_quality_gate_status
tools.description: Get the quality gate status of a project (OK/ERROR) plus the failing conditions with metric, actual value, and threshold.

branch.description: Branch name (defaults to the main branch)

tools.name: sonar.search_issues
tools.description: Search issues (bugs, vulnerabilities, code smells), optionally filtered by project, severity, type, status, and assignee.

assignees.description: Comma-separated assignee logins ('__me__' for the token owner)

tools.name: sonar.search_hotspots
tools.description: Search security hotspots of a project, with security category, vulnerability probability, file, and line.

projectKey.description: Project key to search hotspots in

status.description: Hotspot status filter: TO_REVIEW or REVIEWED

tools.name: sonar.get_measures
tools.description: Get current metric values for a component (project, directory, or file) as metric/value pairs. Defaults to coverage, duplicated_lines_density, ncloc, complexity, reliability_rating, security_rating, sqale_rating.

component.description: Component key (project key, or a file/directory key)

metricKeys.description: Comma-separated metric keys to fetch (overrides the default set)

tools.name: sonar.get_analysis_history
tools.description: Get the historical values of metrics for a component over past analyses, as date/value series per metric.

limit.description: Max history points per page (default 25, max 100)

tools.name: sonar.assign_issue
tools.description: Assign an issue to a user (or unassign it when no assignee is given).

assignee.description: Login of the new assignee; omit to unassign
